title: PDF Study Tool for Mac — Textbook Notes | Margin
excerpt: A PDF study tool for Mac. Take notes in textbooks, organize ideas in scratchpads, and pick up where you left off. $39 once; $19 for students.

Inline notes

Go ahead.

Ask a question. Explain an idea in your own words. Margin opens space for your notes without changing your original PDF.

Before you get started.

Will it work with my textbooks?

Margin opens PDFs from your Mac. PDFs with selectable text work best for placing notes precisely. Scanned pages and complex layouts may offer fewer places to add notes. It supports documents up to 2,000 pages and 300 MB.

Which Macs can run Margin?

Margin runs on Apple silicon Macs (M1 or newer) with macOS 14 Sonoma or later. The current release does not support Intel Macs.

Where are my notes saved?

Your notes and scratchpads are saved locally in the Margin workspace on your Mac. Your PDF stays at its original location. Keep that file available and back up your workspace to keep your study work safe.

Do I need a subscription or an account?

No. Margin is a one-time purchase, and you don’t need a Margin account. Reading, taking notes, and using scratchpads work offline. You’ll need an internet connection to purchase and download the app.

How do I get the student price?

Email [email protected] from your .edu email address to request a student discount code. The student price is $19 USD, paid once, for the same app.
